cards.caption: The city offers a route only to someone willing to commit.
The bright terraces end at a door that was buried from the inside.
Two fighters can turn one dry stair into contested ground.
A lance meets a charging shoulder before the route gives way.
He opens the blocked route with a single controlled strike.
Their best route crosses the path of something that can move the skyline.
